simple.meaning: פְּלוֹנִי (Pᵉlôwnîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Pelonite or inhabitant of an unknown Palon.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פְּלוֹנִי (H6397) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 11:27, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פְּלוֹנִי (H6397) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פְּלוֹנִי (H6397) before moving outward to related references.
